findings.text: The new condition (`<14.17.0` or `>=15.0.0 && <16.0.0`) no longer forces x64 for v14.17.0–v14.x on darwin/arm64. As the comment admits, no darwin-arm64 binaries exist before v16, so `nvm install 14.21.3` on an M1 Mac now requests a nonexistent darwin-arm64 tarball and fails with a 404 or falls back to a source build. The old `<16.0.0` check worked for these versions.
